title.narrative: Building of Level II hospitals in Beira

description.narrative: Two level II hospitals will be developed implemented and operated in Beira (port city) and Marromeu (rural area) hence strategically expanding access in the province and region. The project consists of health infrastructure equipment and training. In addition technical assistance and institutional strengthening are part of the project.
